subject.title: Clarify status of optional bird transport

question: Should Birdclaw docs now treat `xurl` as the public new-user live transport and describe `bird` as private or existing-install-only, or will `bird` get a maintained public distribution path?
rationale: The source still supports bird and the docs still recommend it, but the public npm/GitHub install path is not reliable enough for automation to choose the support stance safely.

options.title: Document xurl as public default
options.body: Keep bird code paths for existing users, but update public docs to make xurl the new-user path and mark bird as private or existing-install-only until a public path exists.

options.title: Restore public bird distribution
options.body: Undeprecate or republish the bird package/repository, then keep Birdclaw docs pointing users at the restored public install path.

options.title: Pause docs changes
options.body: Leave the docs unchanged until the external bird package/repository policy is resolved, accepting the current setup confusion.

recommendation.title: Document xurl as public default
recommendation.body: Keep bird code paths for existing users, but update public docs to make xurl the new-user path and mark bird as private or existing-install-only until a public path exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision depends on the steipete-owned bird package/repository status and Birdclaw's public transport recommendation.
